ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction. NVDA reports Q2 FY2027 after close on August 26 with consensus expecting ~96% YoY revenue growth and EPS of ~$2.09-$2.13 (~2x YoY), yet the stock trades at only ~21-25x forward earnings — at or near S&P 500 parity — far below its historical 35-40x range. The 68-analyst average price target of $303.09 vs. current ~$225 implies a ~35% upside gap, with revenue estimates revised up 6.67% in the past 3 months. A defined-risk call spread (Aug 29 expiry) is preferred over outright stock given elevated pre-earnings IV and the binary event risk compounded by Warsh's Jackson Hole speech landing 36 hours later.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY2027 earnings report after market close on August 26, 2026; Warsh Jackson Hole keynote 36 hours later on August 28
ideas.edge: 68 analysts hold avg PT of $303.09 vs ~$225 current (~35% upside gap); stock trades at ~21-25x forward earnings vs. 35-40x historical range — multiple re-rate to 30x alone implies 20%+ upside; revenue estimates revised up 6.67% in 3 months
ideas.bull_case: A beat-and-raise on Blackwell/Vera Rubin demand — consistent with NVDA's history of topping consensus — triggers a multiple re-rate from ~25x back toward 30x+, with Warsh's tone acting as a secondary catalyst if neutral; analyst PT gap closes toward $303.
ideas.bear_case: Sell-the-news risk is real if guidance merely meets (not beats) elevated expectations; a hawkish Warsh speech 36 hours later could compress tech multiples just as the stock attempts to rally, and elevated pre-earnings IV inflates option premiums.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (ADR)
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens, making it the most consistent equity long idea in this cycle. SKHY is the highest-beta pure-play on NVDA's earnings outcome via its $500B+ Nvidia–SK Group AI infrastructure partnership locking in multi-year HBM memory supply. A KRW 40 trillion (~$29B) share buyback announced August 19 provides a mechanical price floor, and the stock has pulled back ~13% from its ~$178 high to ~$163, offering a re-entry near support ahead of multiple stacked catalysts. With a beta of ~2.4x, a strong NVDA print on August 26 would amplify upside disproportionately; JPMorgan and Barclays both reiterate Buy.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA Q2 FY2027 earnings Aug 26 as direct read-through; $29B buyback announced Aug 19; US hyperscaler HBM contract confirmations expected around South Korean state visit
ideas.edge: Beta of 2.4x mechanically amplifies NVDA earnings beat; stock is ~13% off recent $178 high despite intact $500B+ partnership and fresh $29B buyback acting as a price floor; Barclays Buy reiterated Aug 20, JPMorgan also bullish
ideas.bull_case: NVDA beats on Aug 26, directly validating HBM demand tied to Blackwell/Vera Rubin roadmap; buyback mechanically absorbs selling; stock reverts toward $178 high or beyond as AI memory supply contracts get publicly confirmed.
ideas.bear_case: Extreme 2.4 beta cuts both ways — a NVDA miss or hawkish Warsh speech would amplify downside sharply; ADR liquidity and FX risk (KRW exposure) add complexity; options availability on SKHY ADR should be verified before sizing for defined-risk positioning.

ideas.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (Nasdaq-100 ETF)
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens, though all 6 conviction votes were medium — reflecting the hedging/tactical nature of the idea rather than a directional long. Three macro catalysts (PCE, NVDA earnings, Jackson Hole) are stacked within a 48-hour window this week, creating a compressed binary volatility event at index level. The Nasdaq-100 is already down ~3% in 5 days on a yield spike, and QQQ's significant NVDA weighting means it captures both the earnings and macro catalyst simultaneously. Options (straddle, call spread, or put spread depending on directional view) offer superior defined-risk expression vs. single-name alternatives.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA earnings Aug 26 + Warsh Jackson Hole keynote Aug 28 — dual macro/earnings event window within 48 hours
ideas.edge: Nasdaq-100 down ~3% in 5 days on rising yields with September hike odds at ~55%; three stacked catalysts create binary vol event; QQQ provides superior liquidity vs. single-name options for event hedging or directional swing
ideas.bull_case: NVDA beats and Warsh strikes a neutral or data-dependent tone — QQQ call spread captures index-level upside with NVDA weighting amplifying the move, and some hawkish risk is already partially priced in via recent selloff.
ideas.bear_case: A hawkish Warsh debut speech (55% Sept hike odds, 3 FOMC dissenters) would be a large negative surprise for rate-sensitive tech; elevated yields near 20-year highs already compress multiples, and a QQQ put spread would pay off but the cost of protection is meaningful given elevated IV.
